title: Royal Ivory & Sapphire
intro: Ivory doors sealed with a navy Khanda. A tap plays a short film: the gold shimmers, the doors open on a Gurudwara across still water, and the couple stand before it with their names in the sky. One continuous scroll follows — the blessing of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, both families, the programme, every event on its own gold-edged card, and a sunset over the sarovar to close.
included: A short film of the doors opening, with its own music
Ik Onkar and the blessing of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
Both families named, the way the card is printed
The whole programme at a glance, and every event on its own card with a map
Calendar files that open straight into iPhone and Android calendars
A countdown to the Anand Karaj, in each guest's own time
Two links from one invitation — with or without the Mehndi night
Each guest greeted by name, and RSVP on WhatsApp
A Laavan recording that plays from the first tap
